aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer, identified in the supplied row context as NCCN high-risk prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide the NCCN criteria.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: In the pooled data set, high calcium intake was significantly associated with higher odds for aggressive prostate cancer (OR<sub>Quartile 1 vs. Quartile 4</sub> = 1.98, 95% C.I.: 1.01-3.91), while high vitamin D intake was associated with lower odds of aggressive prostate cancer (OR<sub>Quartile 1 vs. Quartile 4</sub> = 0.38, 95% C.I.: 0.18-0.79).
study_design: Case-control study of screened prostate cancer patients and healthy controls.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 1,657 prostate cancer patients who underwent screening and healthy controls (888 African Americans, 620 European Americans, 111 Hispanic Americans, and 38 others) from Chicago, IL and Washington, D.C. were included in this study.
reason: The abstract explicitly analyzes aggressive prostate cancer for calcium and vitamin D and also reports an association with prostate cancer without an aggressive qualifier among African Americans, establishing both aggressive and general incident case-control endpoints. Total aggressive cases are not reported in the abstract; the supplied row-specific counts are not overall aggressive case counts.
